delivery: Unterjährige Datenlieferung DRG Januar bis Dezember 2025
scope: Diagnosis outcomes only. Procedural endpoints require an independent AND procedure selector; never add them to the cohort OPS OR field.
query_logic: OR within each selector; AND across selectors. Dysphagia ND and outcome further-ND selectors are distinct.

aspiration_pneumonitis.label: Coded pneumonitis/pneumonia due to food and vomit, J69.0 secondary diagnosis

pulmonary_union.label: Coded pneumonia or aspiration-related pneumonitis, J12-J18 or J69.0 unique-case union
pulmonary_union.role: overlapping clinical composite; not independent of component outcomes

malnutrition_union.label: Coded energy/protein malnutrition, E40-E44 or E46 secondary-diagnosis union
malnutrition_union.exclusion: E45 developmental retardation following protein-energy malnutrition is excluded from this adult current-malnutrition definition; E64.0 sequelae, R64 cachexia and Z-codes are not substituted.

volume_depletion.label: Coded volume depletion, E86 secondary diagnosis
volume_depletion.role: clinical outcome; not specific for low-intake dehydration

severe_malnutrition.label: Coded unspecified severe protein-energy malnutrition, E43 secondary diagnosis
severe_malnutrition.role: secondary sensitivity and continuity with original manuscript; subset of malnutrition_union

reference_export_role: Optional verification and full-age crude prevalence; adult analysis remains separate.
zero_rule: No absent query or row is treated as zero. Explicit zero-query handling requires source-backed protocol amendment.

optional_exact_reuse_amendment.required_proof: Existing full-age endpoint source has explicit zero in every minor age group; one opposite adult age-band endpoint source is directly exported and valid.
optional_exact_reuse_amendment.method: Exact subtraction of counts for each age/sex/PCCL category; complete source hashes retained.

full_age_reference_queries.role: optional full-age union reference, no age or principal diagnosis filter
